## Code review checklist (§ 4.4)

- [ ] Code solves the stated problem
- [ ] Code is readable and maintainable
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data are committed
- [ ] Errors are handled appropriately
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] Change is safe to merge

## Definition of Done (§ 6)

- [ ] Requirement is satisfied
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are met
- [ ] Code is reviewed and approved
- [ ] Tests are completed successfully
- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] Change is deployed or ready for deployment
- [ ] Monitoring confirms expected behavior (or N/A for non-prod changes)
- [ ] Follow-up work is documented
